entities.summary: Antonio "Tony" Cairoli is an Italian professional motocross racer. He competed in the Motocross World Championships from 2002 to 2021. Cairoli is notable for winning nine FIM Motocross World Championships. He was also a member of the winning Italian team at the 2021 Motocross des Nations. He currently works as part of the development team for the Ducati brand.
